newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN DATA DUE - German state CPI due from Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN DATA DUE - German state CPI due from Tuesday.

text.p: February consumer price data for four west German states will be released from Tuesday February 25, the state's statistics offices said on Friday.
The states of Hesse and Baden-Wuerttemberg expect to release their data on Tuesday and North Rhine-Westphalia's statistics office said it will release its data on Tuesday or Wednesday.
Bavaria said it would release its data in the course of next week. It did not give a date.
Data from the four states are used to calculate preliminary west German consumer inflation.

In January, west German consumer prices rose 0.5 percent month-on-month and 1.9 percent year-on-year. Pan-German consumer prices rose 0.5 percent month-on-month and 1.8 percent year-on-year. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
